import { insert as _insert, child as _child, txt as _txt, toDisplayString as _toDisplayString, setText as _setText, withModifiers as _withModifiers, on as _on, renderEffect as _renderEffect, template as _template } from 'vue';
const t0 = _template("<form><button>Search</button></form>")
const t1 = _template("<form></form>")
const t2 = _template("<a href=\"/inner\">inner</a>")
const t3 = _template("<a href=\"/outer\"></a>")
const t4 = _template("<button> </button>")
const t5 = _template("<button></button>")
const t6 = _template("<ul><li> </li></ul>")
const t7 = _template("<p></p>")
const t8 = _template("<div>two</div>")
const t9 = _template("<p>three</p>")
const t10 = _template("<p>one</p>")
const t11 = _template("<div> </div>")
const t12 = _template("<table></table>")

function render(_ctx, $props, $emit, $attrs, $slots) {
  const n1 = t1()
  const n3 = t3()
  const n5 = t5()
  const n7 = t7()
  const n11 = t10()
  const n13 = t12()
  const n0 = t0()
  const n2 = t2()
  const n4 = t4()
  const n6 = t6()
  const n8 = _child(n6)
  const n9 = t8()
  const n10 = t9()
  const n12 = t11()
  const x4 = _txt(n4)
  const x8 = _txt(n8)
  const x12 = _txt(n12)
  _on(n1, "submit", _withModifiers(e => _ctx.save(e), ["prevent"]))
  _insert(n0, n1)
  _on(n0, "submit", _withModifiers(e => _ctx.search(e), ["prevent"]))
  _insert(n2, n3)
  _on(n5, "click", e => _ctx.outer(e))
  _insert(n4, n5)
  _on(n4, "click", e => _ctx.inner(e))
  _insert(n6, n7)
  _insert(n9, n11)
  _insert(n10, n11)
  _insert(n12, n13)
  _renderEffect(() => {
    _setText(x4, _toDisplayString(_ctx.label))
    _setText(x8, _toDisplayString(_ctx.item))
    _setText(x12, _toDisplayString(_ctx.note))
  })
  return [n1, n3, n5, n7, n11, n13]
}
const _sfc_main = { __vapor: true }
_sfc_main.render = render
export default _sfc_main
